routes.name: BE Computer / Software / IT Engineering
routes.entry: +2 Science (Physical) or equivalent diploma with Maths
routes.about: The most competitive route into software, networks and data. Quality varies a lot between colleges, so check labs, alumni jobs and the pass rate.
routes.exam: IOE entrance (TU), KUEE (KU), PU and other university entrances

routes.name: BE Civil Engineering
routes.about: Roads, hydropower, buildings and water. Nepal's construction and hydropower projects keep steady demand, with registration in the Nepal Engineering Council.

routes.name: MBBS (Medicine)
routes.entry: +2 Science (Biology) with the minimum marks set by the medical education commission
routes.about: Government quota seats are cheap and fiercely contested. Private seats cost far more. Nepal Medical Council licence is required to practise.
routes.exam: Common entrance (MECEE) run by the national medical education authority

routes.name: BSc Nursing
routes.entry: +2 Science (Biology) or PCL nursing with experience
routes.about: Strong demand at home and abroad. Licence from the Nepal Nursing Council.
routes.exam: University entrance (TU, KU, PU or BPKIHS)

routes.name: BPharm (Pharmacy)
routes.entry: +2 Science (Biology or Physical) or diploma in pharmacy
routes.about: Hospital, retail and industry pharmacy. Nepal Pharmacy Council registration needed.

routes.name: BSc CSIT
routes.entry: +2 Science or +2 with Maths and Computer
routes.about: Theory-heavy computer science degree from Tribhuvan University. Good foundation for software, analytics and masters abroad.
routes.exam: TU CSIT entrance (CMAT-style), run per college

routes.name: BCA (Computer Applications)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream (Maths or Computer helps)
routes.about: Application-focused computing: web, mobile and databases. Open to management and science students.
routes.exam: TU or PU entrance as set by the college

routes.name: BBS (Bachelor of Business Studies)
routes.about: The most popular management degree in Nepal. Low cost, easy to study alongside a job.

routes.name: BBA (Business Administration)
routes.about: Practice-led business degree with projects, internships and presentations. Pokhara University, Kathmandu University and TU affiliates.
routes.exam: Entrance or aptitude test and interview

routes.name: BHM (Hotel Management)
routes.about: Hotels, resorts, airlines and cruise jobs. Strong overseas hiring.

routes.name: BA (Humanities and Social Sciences)
routes.about: Sociology, English, Nepali, Political Science, Psychology and more. A flexible base for civil service, teaching and research.

routes.name: BJMC (Journalism and Mass Communication)
routes.about: Reporting, editing, video and digital media. Portfolio matters more than the certificate.

routes.name: BSW (Social Work)
routes.about: Community development, NGOs and government programmes.

routes.name: BEd (Education)
routes.about: Needed for most permanent teaching posts with a teaching licence from the Teacher Service Commission.

routes.name: LLB (Law)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream (5 year) or any bachelor degree (3 year)
routes.about: Bar council exam is needed to practise. Courts, corporate legal teams and government legal work.
routes.exam: University entrance, then Nepal Bar Council exam

routes.name: BSc Agriculture
routes.about: Government, NGOs and agri-business. Agriculture is Nepal's largest employer, and modern farm tech is growing.

routes.name: B.Arch (Architecture)
routes.entry: +2 Science with Maths or a diploma
routes.about: Design studio-based degree. A portfolio and drawing speed help in the entrance.
routes.exam: IOE or KU entrance with drawing test
